examples.en: The team analyzed the data from three surveys.
examples.zh: 团队分析了三次调查的数据。

examples.en: The committee consists of nine members.
examples.zh: 委员会由九名成员组成。

examples.en: Women constitute 60% of the student body.
examples.zh: 女生占学生总数的 60%。

examples.en: Applicants are judged against strict criteria.
examples.zh: 申请人要按严格的标准来评判。

examples.en: The university established the centre in 1998.
examples.zh: 这所大学于 1998 年建立了该中心。

examples.en: It was evident that the plan had failed.
examples.zh: 显然这个计划失败了。

examples.en: The job involves a lot of travel.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要经常出差。

examples.en: All passengers are required to wear a seatbelt.
examples.zh: 所有乘客都必须系安全带。

examples.en: Read the third section of the report.
examples.zh: 读报告的第三节。

examples.en: The private sector creates most new jobs.
examples.zh: 私营部门创造了大部分新岗位。

examples.en: There was a significant rise in costs.
examples.zh: 成本显著上涨。

examples.en: A trust administers the scholarship fund.
examples.zh: 一项信托管理着奖学金基金。

examples.en: Many doctors advocate a plant-based diet.
examples.zh: 许多医生提倡以植物为主的饮食。

examples.en: The aggregate score decided the winner.
examples.zh: 总分决定了获胜者。

examples.en: We anticipate strong demand in spring.
examples.zh: 我们预计春季需求旺盛。

examples.en: She attributes her success to daily practice.
examples.zh: 她把成功归因于每日练习。

examples.en: The hall has a seating capacity of 500.
examples.zh: 礼堂可容纳 500 人就座。

meaning: adj. 连贯的,条理清楚的

examples.en: A good essay needs a coherent argument.
examples.zh: 好文章需要连贯的论证。

examples.en: They compiled a list of safety rules.
examples.zh: 他们汇编了一份安全守则。

examples.en: The committee conferred for two hours.
examples.zh: 委员会商讨了两个小时。

meaning: v. 限制, confined to 局限于

examples.en: Please confine your comments to the topic.
examples.zh: 请把意见限制在本话题内。

examples.en: Budget cuts constrained the research plan.
examples.zh: 预算削减限制了研究计划。

examples.en: The area was designated a national park.
examples.zh: 该地区被指定为国家公园。

examples.en: Sensors detect smoke in the tunnel.
examples.zh: 传感器检测隧道里的烟雾。

examples.en: The plane deviated from its planned route.
examples.zh: 飞机偏离了预定航线。

examples.en: Engineers devised a cheaper cooling system.
examples.zh: 工程师设计出更便宜的冷却系统。

examples.en: In this map, red circles denote hospitals.
examples.zh: 在这张地图上,红圈表示医院。

examples.en: No one should be deprived of education.
examples.zh: 任何人都不应被剥夺受教育的权利。

examples.en: I could discern a hint of irony in her voice.
examples.zh: 我能听出她话里的一丝讽刺。

examples.en: Fears that robots would displace workers grew.
examples.zh: 对机器人取代工人的担忧加剧了。

meaning: v. 处理;倾向于(dispose of 丢弃)

examples.en: The factory disposed of its waste safely.
examples.zh: 工厂安全地处理了废弃物。

examples.en: Headlines often distort the facts.
examples.zh: 标题常常歪曲事实。

examples.en: Two companies dominate the market.
examples.zh: 两家公司主导着市场。

examples.en: The new filter eliminates bad smells.
examples.zh: 新滤芯消除了异味。

examples.en: The city embraced the bike-sharing idea.
examples.zh: 这座城市欣然接受了共享单车的理念。

examples.en: We encountered several problems early on.
examples.zh: 我们起初遇到了几个问题。

examples.en: She endeavored to keep the team calm.
examples.zh: 她努力让团队保持冷静。

examples.en: The results exceeded all expectations.
examples.zh: 结果超出了所有预期。

examples.en: Prices exclude delivery charges.
examples.zh: 价格不含运费。

examples.en: The gallery exhibits modern paintings.
examples.zh: 美术馆展出现代绘画。

examples.en: The report exposed serious flaws.
examples.zh: 报告揭露了严重缺陷。

examples.en: The board formulated a new strategy.
examples.zh: 董事会制定了新战略。

examples.en: Reading fosters imagination in children.
examples.zh: 阅读培养孩子的想象力。

examples.en: Heavy rain hindered the rescue work.
examples.zh: 大雨阻碍了救援工作。

examples.en: The study illuminates a forgotten chapter of history.
examples.zh: 这项研究阐明了被遗忘的历史篇章。

examples.en: The new design incorporates user feedback.
examples.zh: 新设计纳入了用户反馈。

examples.en: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity.
examples.zh: 对失败的恐惧会抑制创造力。

examples.en: The company initiated a recall of the product.
examples.zh: 公司发起了产品召回。

examples.en: The app integrates booking and payment.
examples.zh: 这款应用整合了预订与支付。

examples.en: The storm intensified overnight.
examples.zh: 风暴在一夜之间加剧了。

examples.en: The referee intervened to stop the fight.
examples.zh: 裁判介入制止了斗殴。

examples.en: Ads manipulate our desire to belong.
examples.zh: 广告操纵我们的归属感。

examples.en: The charity mobilized volunteers within days.
examples.zh: 慈善机构几天内就动员了志愿者。

examples.en: One late payment negated the discount.
examples.zh: 一次逾期付款使折扣失效了。

examples.en: Clouds obscured the mountain top.
examples.zh: 云雾遮住了山顶。

examples.en: His report omitted the key figures.
examples.zh: 他的报告遗漏了关键数据。

examples.en: Our shifts overlap on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我们周五的班次有重叠。

examples.en: Common sense finally prevailed.
examples.zh: 常识最终占了上风。

examples.en: The treatment prolongs patients' lives.
examples.zh: 这种治疗延长了病人的生命。

examples.en: The evidence reinforced her argument.
examples.zh: 证据加强了她的论点。

examples.en: Other labs failed to replicate the results.
examples.zh: 其他实验室未能复制这些结果。

examples.en: He could barely restrain his anger.
examples.zh: 他几乎无法克制怒火。

examples.en: The new rules restrict parking downtown.
examples.zh: 新规定限制市中心停车。

examples.en: A brief note will suffice.
examples.zh: 一张简短的字条就够了。

examples.en: She suppressed a laugh during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在会议中忍住了笑。

examples.en: The soil cannot sustain intensive farming.
examples.zh: 这片土壤无法支撑精耕细作。

examples.en: Great music transcends language barriers.
examples.zh: 伟大的音乐超越语言障碍。

examples.en: The tower transmits radio signals.
examples.zh: 这座塔传输无线电信号。

examples.en: The discovery created a new paradigm in physics.
examples.zh: 这一发现开创了物理学的新范式。

examples.en: Lightning is a natural phenomenon.
examples.zh: 闪电是一种自然现象。

examples.en: The implications of the law are unclear.
examples.zh: 这部法律的影响尚不明确。

examples.en: The paper explains its methodology in detail.
examples.zh: 论文详细说明了研究方法。

examples.en: Quantitative data showed a small decline.
examples.zh: 定量数据显示小幅下降。

examples.en: The report includes qualitative interviews.
examples.zh: 报告包含定性访谈。

examples.en: Scientists studied the cooling mechanism.
examples.zh: 科学家研究了这种冷却机制。

examples.en: The problem has a moral dimension.
examples.zh: 这个问题有道德层面。

examples.en: Trust is a key component of friendship.
examples.zh: 信任是友谊的关键组成部分。

examples.en: Keep the temperature as a fixed variable.
examples.zh: 把温度保持为固定变量。

examples.en: Work within the agreed parameters.
examples.zh: 在商定的范围内工作。

examples.en: The theorem is taught in first-year algebra.
examples.zh: 这条定理在一年级代数课上讲授。

examples.en: This idea belongs to the realm of fiction.
examples.zh: 这个想法属于虚构的领域。

examples.en: Editing is outside my domain of expertise.
examples.zh: 编辑不在我的专业领域内。

examples.en: The scandal was a catalyst for reform.
examples.zh: 丑闻成了改革的催化剂。

examples.en: These protests were a precursor of wider change.
examples.zh: 这些抗议是更大变革的前兆。

examples.en: Speed is the essence of the sport.
examples.zh: 速度是这项运动的精髓。

examples.en: The party's ideology shifted over time.
examples.zh: 该党的意识形态随时间发生了变化。

examples.en: The court overturned the old doctrine.
examples.zh: 法院推翻了旧学说。

examples.en: The axiom seems self-evident to mathematicians.
examples.zh: 这条公理在数学家看来不证自明。

examples.en: What inference can we draw from this data?
examples.zh: 我们从这些数据能得出什么推论?

examples.en: He showed no inclination to apologize.
examples.zh: 他没有表现出道歉的意愿。

examples.en: The course covers a wide spectrum of topics.
examples.zh: 这门课涵盖广泛的主题。

examples.en: They failed to grasp the magnitude of the crisis.
examples.zh: 他们没有意识到危机的严重程度。

examples.en: The campaign gained momentum in October.
examples.zh: 运动在十月份势头渐强。

examples.en: He has a tendency to arrive late.
examples.zh: 他有迟到的倾向。

examples.en: She has a cheerful disposition.
examples.zh: 她性情开朗。

examples.en: There is a strong correlation between sleep and grades.
examples.zh: 睡眠与成绩高度相关。

examples.en: Correlation does not prove causation.
examples.zh: 相关性不能证明因果关系。

examples.en: The warm winter was an anomaly in the records.
examples.zh: 暖冬在记录中是个异常现象。

examples.en: The auditor found a discrepancy in the accounts.
examples.zh: 审计员发现账目不一致。

examples.en: It's a paradox that busier people often rest better.
examples.zh: 更忙的人反而休息得更好,这是个悖论。

examples.en: The contract's ambiguity led to a dispute.
examples.zh: 合同的模糊表述引发了争议。

examples.en: Students struggled with the complexity of the topic.
examples.zh: 学生们被主题的复杂性难住了。

examples.en: The two firms merged into one legal entity.
examples.zh: 两家公司合并为一个法律实体。

examples.en: The government launched a new green initiative.
examples.zh: 政府发起了新的环保倡议。

examples.en: Early intervention improved the outcome.
examples.zh: 早期干预改善了结果。

examples.en: Time is the main constraint on the project.
examples.zh: 时间是该项目的主要限制。

examples.en: The lens creates a slight distortion at the edges.
examples.zh: 镜头边缘会产生轻微畸变。

examples.en: Critics questioned the validity of the survey.
examples.zh: 批评者质疑调查的有效性。

examples.en: The car is known for its reliability.
examples.zh: 这款车以可靠著称。

examples.en: The mistake damaged the paper's credibility.
examples.zh: 这个错误损害了论文的可信度。

examples.en: It is noteworthy that sales held steady.
examples.zh: 值得注意的是销售额保持稳定。

examples.en: The report highlights the salient features of the plan.
examples.zh: 报告突出强调了计划的显著特点。

examples.en: There is a subtle difference between the two wines.
examples.zh: 这两种葡萄酒有细微的差别。

examples.en: The war had a profound effect on literature.
examples.zh: 战争对文学产生了深远影响。

examples.en: Don't waste time on trivial details.
examples.zh: 别在琐碎细节上浪费时间。

examples.en: The cost difference is negligible.
examples.zh: 成本差异微不足道。

examples.en: The reform had only a marginal effect.
examples.zh: 改革效果甚微。

examples.en: The company took drastic measures to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司采取极端措施削减成本。

examples.en: The drug produced no appreciable improvement.
examples.zh: 这种药物没有产生明显改善。

examples.en: The proposition sounds simple but is hard to test.
examples.zh: 这个命题听起来简单,检验起来却很难。

examples.en: Her contention is that homework helps little.
examples.zh: 她的论点是家庭作业作用甚微。

examples.en: The article offered a sharp rebuttal of the claim.
examples.zh: 文章对该说法提出了尖锐反驳。

examples.en: The lawyer could not substantiate the allegation.
examples.zh: 律师无法证实这一指控。

examples.en: Two witnesses corroborated her account.
examples.zh: 两名证人印证了她的说法。

examples.en: New evidence invalidated the earlier conclusion.
examples.zh: 新证据推翻了早先的结论。

meaning: v. 败坏名声;使不可信

examples.en: The leaks were meant to discredit the journalist.
examples.zh: 泄露行为意在败坏记者的名声。

examples.en: That's a plausible explanation for the delay.
examples.zh: 这是对延误的一个合理解释。

examples.en: She made a cogent case for reform.
examples.zh: 她为改革提出了有力的论证。

examples.en: The method passed rigorous testing.
examples.zh: 该方法通过了严格测试。

examples.en: We've set a tentative date for the launch.
examples.zh: 我们暂定了发布日期。

examples.en: The answer was an unequivocal no.
examples.zh: 答案是毫不含糊的"不"。

examples.en: The film juxtaposes wealth and poverty.
examples.zh: 影片将贫富并置对比。

examples.en: The essay synthesizes findings from ten studies.
examples.zh: 文章综合了十项研究的发现。

examples.en: It's risky to extrapolate from one small sample.
examples.zh: 从小样本外推是有风险的。

examples.en: Every good essay addresses a counterargument.
examples.zh: 好文章都要回应反方论点。

examples.en: The plan has both merits and risks.
examples.zh: 这个计划既有优点也有风险。

examples.en: One caveat: results may vary by region.
examples.zh: 有一点需要注意:结果可能因地区而异。

examples.en: That claim is too broad a generalization.
examples.zh: 那种说法过于以偏概全。

examples.en: Any summary will oversimplify the debate.
examples.zh: 任何摘要都会把争论过度简化。

examples.en: The article shows a clear political bias.
examples.zh: 这篇文章带有明显的政治偏见。

examples.en: The referee must stay neutral.
examples.zh: 裁判必须保持中立。

examples.en: Try to give an objective assessment.
examples.zh: 尽量给出客观评价。

examples.en: Taste in music is highly subjective.
examples.zh: 音乐品味是非常主观的。

examples.en: Skeptics questioned the company's numbers.
examples.zh: 怀疑者质疑该公司的数据。

examples.en: The deal came under close scrutiny.
examples.zh: 这笔交易受到严格审查。

examples.en: The journal published a critique of the model.
examples.zh: 期刊刊发了一篇对该模型的评论。

examples.en: Proponents say the tax cuts will spur growth.
examples.zh: 支持者说减税将刺激增长。

examples.en: Opponents of the plan marched downtown.
examples.zh: 反对该计划的人在市中心游行。

examples.en: He saw his business rival as a worthy adversary.
examples.zh: 他把商业对手视为值得尊敬的对手。

examples.en: The bridge widened the road, thereby easing traffic.
examples.zh: 大桥拓宽了道路,从而缓解了交通。

examples.en: The report describes a system wherein users control the data.
examples.zh: 报告描述了一种由用户掌控数据的系统。

examples.en: Police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方正试图查明起火原因。

examples.en: The essay delineates the stages of the conflict.
examples.zh: 文章勾勒出冲突的各个阶段。

examples.en: The professor elucidated the theory with two examples.
examples.zh: 教授用两个例子阐明了该理论。

examples.en: The incident underscores the need for backups.
examples.zh: 这一事件突出了备份的必要性。

examples.en: Her career exemplifies the new mobility of talent.
examples.zh: 她的职业经历是人才新流动性的典型。

examples.en: These narrow streets typify the old town.
examples.zh: 这些狭窄街道是老城区的典型。

examples.en: The building embodies the spirit of the age.
examples.zh: 这座建筑体现了时代精神。

meaning: v. 集中体现,是……的缩影

examples.en: The resort epitomizes understated luxury.
examples.zh: 这家度假村是低调奢华的缩影。

examples.en: Stress often manifests as sleep problems.
examples.zh: 压力常表现为睡眠问题。

examples.en: It's hard to quantify the benefits of exercise.
examples.zh: 锻炼的好处难以量化。

examples.en: Her remarks qualified the earlier statement.
examples.zh: 她的话对之前的说法作了限定。

examples.en: The airline rectified the booking error at once.
examples.zh: 航空公司立即纠正了预订错误。

examples.en: New drainage ameliorated the flooding.
examples.zh: 新排水系统改善了洪涝问题。

examples.en: Scratching will only aggravate the rash.
examples.zh: 抓挠只会让皮疹更严重。

examples.en: Cuts in funding exacerbated the shortage.
examples.zh: 资金削减加剧了短缺。

examples.en: The scandal precipitated the minister's resignation.
examples.zh: 丑闻促成了部长的辞职。

examples.en: Please expedite the delivery of the documents.
examples.zh: 请加快文件的递送。

meaning: n. 内涵意义,联想意义

examples.en: The word "cheap" carries negative connotations.
examples.zh: "cheap"一词带有负面联想意义。

examples.en: The translator missed every nuance of the poem.
examples.zh: 译者错过了这首诗的所有细微意蕴。

examples.en: There was overt hostility between the teams.
examples.zh: 两队之间存在公开的敌意。

examples.en: The agency ran a covert operation.
examples.zh: 该机构执行了一次秘密行动。

examples.en: The instructions were explicit about the deadline.
examples.zh: 说明明确提到了截止日期。

examples.en: There was an implicit criticism in her question.
examples.zh: 她的问题里暗含批评。

examples.en: Risk is inherent in any investment.
examples.zh: 风险是任何投资固有的。

examples.en: Curiosity has intrinsic value beyond grades.
examples.zh: 好奇心有超越分数的内在价值。

examples.en: The watch has an intricate mechanism.
examples.zh: 这块表的机械结构错综复杂。

meaning: adj. 盘绕的;晦涩难懂的

examples.en: The manual's convoluted prose confused everyone.
examples.zh: 手册晦涩的文字把大家都搞糊涂了。

examples.en: Give a succinct summary of the findings.
examples.zh: 对研究结果作一个简明扼要的总结。

meaning: n. 字面意义,指称意义

examples.en: "Snake" in its denotation simply means the animal.
examples.zh: "snake"的字面意义只是指这种动物。

meaning: n. 潜在意味,弦外之音

examples.en: The speech had an angry undertone.
examples.zh: 这场演讲暗含怒气。

examples.en: Extrinsic rewards can weaken intrinsic motivation.
examples.zh: 外在奖励可能削弱内在动机。

meaning: adj. 清晰易懂的;清醒的

examples.en: She wrote a lucid account of the trial.
examples.zh: 她对庭审写了清晰的报道。

examples.en: His verbose emails rarely get read.
examples.zh: 他冗长的邮件很少有人读完。

meaning: adj. 雄辩的,有说服力的

examples.en: The lawyer gave an eloquent closing speech.
examples.zh: 律师做了雄辩的结案陈词。

examples.en: The town's population dwindled after the mine closed.
examples.zh: 矿井关闭后,小镇人口逐渐减少。

examples.en: Years of stagnation followed the boom.
examples.zh: 繁荣之后是多年的停滞。

examples.en: The proliferation of apps worries parents.
examples.zh: 应用的激增令家长担忧。

examples.en: The city saw a resurgence of street markets.
examples.zh: 这座城市见证了街头市场的复兴。

examples.en: The announcement led to the dissolution of the board.
examples.zh: 这一公告导致董事会解散。

examples.en: The advent of smartphones changed photography.
examples.zh: 智能手机的出现改变了摄影。

examples.en: The onset of winter caught drivers off guard.
examples.zh: 冬天来得突然,让司机措手不及。

examples.en: From the outset, the plan looked risky.
examples.zh: 从一开始,这个计划就显得冒险。

meaning: n. 顶点, culmination of ……的最终成果

examples.en: The festival was the culmination of months of work.
examples.zh: 这次节庆是数月工作的结晶。

examples.en: The property is just above the tax threshold.
examples.zh: 这处房产刚好超过起税门槛。

examples.en: Winning the award was the pinnacle of her career.
examples.zh: 获奖是她事业的顶峰。

examples.en: The bank reached the apex of its power in 1900.
examples.zh: 这家银行在 1900 年达到势力顶峰。

examples.en: The empire was at its zenith a century ago.
examples.zh: 这个帝国一个世纪前处于鼎盛时期。

meaning: adj. 易波动的,不稳定的

examples.en: Stocks were volatile all week.
examples.zh: 股市整周起伏不定。

examples.en: Sales were sluggish in the first quarter.
examples.zh: 第一季度销售疲软。

examples.en: The data supports a robust conclusion.
examples.zh: 这些数据支持一个有力的结论。

meaning: adj. 有韧性的,能快速恢复的

examples.en: Coral reefs are less resilient than we thought.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁的恢复力比我们想象的弱。

examples.en: The ceasefire remains fragile.
examples.zh: 停火依然脆弱。

examples.en: Young trees are susceptible to frost.

examples.en: Reporters compiled a dossier on the plant.
examples.zh: 记者们整理了关于该工厂的卷宗。

examples.en: Grandma's ledger recorded every penny.
examples.zh: 祖母的账本记下了每一分钱。

examples.en: The collective published a short manifesto.
examples.zh: 这个社团发表了一份简短宣言。

examples.en: The almanac predicts a wet harvest.
examples.zh: 年鉴预测收获季节多雨。

examples.en: The city archive holds the original maps.
examples.zh: 市档案馆保存着原始地图。

examples.en: Vacancies are posted in the gazette.
examples.zh: 空缺职位刊登在公报上。

examples.en: A memorandum outlined the new schedule.
examples.zh: 一份备忘录概述了新日程。

examples.en: The talks ended with a brief communique.
examples.zh: 会谈以简短公报收场。

examples.en: The court published the full transcript.
examples.zh: 法院公布了完整笔录。

examples.en: Volunteers handed out a recycling pamphlet.
examples.zh: 志愿者发放了回收小册子。

examples.en: The library keeps periodicals in the basement.
examples.zh: 图书馆把期刊存放在地下室。

examples.en: The radio serial drew loyal listeners.
examples.zh: 这部广播连载拥有忠实听众。

examples.en: The newsstand opens before the first train.
examples.zh: 报摊在首班车前开门。

examples.en: It was her first byline in a national paper.
examples.zh: 这是她第一次在全国性报纸上署名。

examples.en: The dateline read simply "Valparaiso".
examples.zh: 发稿地一栏只写着"瓦尔帕莱索"。

examples.en: The gazetteer lists every hamlet.
examples.zh: 这本地名词典收录了每个村庄。

examples.en: The new editor changed the masthead.
examples.zh: 新主编更换了刊头。

examples.en: The court affirmed the earlier ruling.
examples.zh: 法院维持了先前判决。

examples.en: He avowed his support for the reform.
examples.zh: 他公开宣称支持改革。

examples.en: She professed ignorance of the plan.
examples.zh: 她自称对该计划一无所知。

examples.en: The email purports to be from the bank.
examples.zh: 这封邮件声称来自银行。

examples.en: The model postulates rational shoppers.
examples.zh: 该模型假定购物者是理性的。

examples.en: The study posits a link between noise and stress.
examples.zh: 研究假定噪音与压力存在关联。

examples.en: The question presupposes that costs matter most.
examples.zh: 这个问题预设了成本最重要。

examples.en: Readers conjectured about the ending for weeks.
examples.zh: 读者们对结局猜测了数周。

examples.en: Scientists hypothesized a hidden water source.
examples.zh: 科学家假设存在隐藏水源。

examples.en: We surmised that the delay was weather-related.
examples.zh: 我们推测延误与天气有关。

examples.en: The speech alluded to last summer's outage.
examples.zh: 演讲暗指了去年夏天的宕机。

examples.en: He invoked an old trade rule.
examples.zh: 他援引了一条旧贸易规则。

examples.en: She adduced three studies in her defence.
examples.zh: 她举出三项研究为自己辩护。

examples.en: The debate exposed hidden presuppositions.
examples.zh: 辩论暴露了隐藏的前提。

examples.en: The coach reiterated the safety rules.
examples.zh: 教练重申了安全规则。

examples.en: The team iterates the menu each season.
examples.zh: 团队每季迭代菜单。

examples.en: Lewis recapitulated the argument in one line.
examples.zh: 刘易斯用一句话概括了论点。

examples.en: She enunciated each term slowly.
examples.zh: 她缓慢而清晰地读出每个术语。

examples.en: He found it hard to verbalize the fear.
examples.zh: 他发现很难用语言表达这种恐惧。

examples.en: Patients are asked to vocalize their concerns.
examples.zh: 病人被鼓励说出自己的顾虑。

examples.en: Are you insinuating that I cheated?
examples.zh: 你是在暗示我作弊吗?

examples.en: He intimated that changes were coming.
examples.zh: 他暗示变革即将到来。

examples.en: The ad extols the virtues of slow mornings.
examples.zh: 广告盛赞慢晨光的美好。

examples.en: Critics lauded the film's restraint.
examples.zh: 评论家称赞影片的克制。

examples.en: Speakers eulogized the founder's kindness.
examples.zh: 发言者颂扬创始人的仁厚。

examples.en: Rivals disparaged the small engine.
examples.zh: 对手贬低这台小发动机。

examples.en: Teachers should never belittle slow readers.
examples.zh: 教师绝不该轻视读书慢的孩子。

examples.en: Columnists derided the "smart" fork.
examples.zh: 专栏作家嘲笑那把"智能"叉子。

examples.en: Editorials decried the new parking fees.
examples.zh: 社论谴责新的停车费。

examples.en: The referee admonished the captain.
examples.zh: 裁判告诫了队长。

examples.en: Rising salinity threatens the delta's orchards.
examples.zh: 盐度上升威胁着三角洲的果园。

examples.en: The monsoon arrived two weeks late.
examples.zh: 季风雨迟到了两周。

examples.en: High humidity makes the heat harder to bear.
examples.zh: 高湿度让酷热更难忍受。

examples.en: A wildfire closed the ridge trail.
examples.zh: 一场野火封住了山脊步道。

examples.en: The pesticide was banned after the study.
examples.zh: 这项研究之后该农药被禁用。

examples.en: Farmers cut fertilizer use by a third.
examples.zh: 农民把化肥用量减少了三分之一。

examples.en: Reduced tillage keeps moisture in the soil.
examples.zh: 少耕法能保持土壤水分。

examples.en: Seedlings were laid along each furrow.
examples.zh: 幼苗沿每条犁沟栽种。

examples.en: The old granary now hosts concerts.
examples.zh: 旧粮仓如今举办音乐会。

examples.en: Corn dries slowly in the steel silo.
examples.zh: 玉米在钢筒仓里缓慢干燥。

examples.en: Villagers still thresh wheat by hand.
examples.zh: 村民们仍手工给小麦脱粒。

examples.en: Grafting saved the old apple variety.
examples.zh: 嫁接挽救了老苹果品种。

examples.en: She studies horticulture at the college.
examples.zh: 她在学院学习园艺学。

examples.en: Agronomy improved yields without new land.
examples.zh: 农学在不新增土地的情况下提高了产量。

examples.en: Good husbandry keeps the herd healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的饲养管理让牛群保持健康。

examples.en: Aquaculture now supplies half our seafood.
examples.zh: 水产养殖如今供应我们一半的海鲜。

examples.en: Hydroponics feeds the rooftop restaurant.
examples.zh: 屋顶餐厅的蔬菜来自水培。

examples.en: Composted manure enriches the beds.
examples.zh: 堆肥后的粪肥让苗床更肥沃。

examples.en: The co-op phased out the old herbicide.
examples.zh: 合作社逐步淘汰了老式除草剂。

examples.en: A gentle fungicide stopped the blight.
examples.zh: 一种温和的杀菌剂止住了疫病。

examples.en: The insecticide spared the bees this time.
examples.zh: 这次杀虫剂没有伤到蜜蜂。

examples.en: Sunday weeding became a family ritual.
examples.zh: 周日除草成了全家的固定活动。

examples.en: Careful pruning doubled the bloom.
examples.zh: 细心修剪使开花量翻倍。

examples.en: Arid land covers the province's north.
examples.zh: 干旱土地覆盖该省北部。

examples.en: Verdant hills ring the quiet bay.
examples.zh: 翠绿群山环绕着安静的海湾。

examples.en: Fallow fields recovered their fertility.
examples.zh: 休耕的田地恢复了肥力。

examples.en: The valley keeps its pastoral calm.
examples.zh: 山谷保持着田园般的宁静。

examples.en: Agrarian reform reshaped the region.
examples.zh: 土地改革重塑了该地区。

examples.en: This cultivar resists late frosts.
examples.zh: 这个栽培品种能抵御晚霜。

examples.en: Bees pollinate the almond orchards each spring.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂每年春天为杏园授粉。

examples.en: Rapid urbanization reshaped the coast.
examples.zh: 快速城市化重塑了海岸线。

examples.en: The megalopolis swallows three old towns.
examples.zh: 这个特大都市圈吞并了三座老城。

examples.en: The municipality repaints crosswalks each spring.
examples.zh: 市政当局每年春天重刷人行横道。

examples.en: The township voted to keep its small school.
examples.zh: 镇区投票保留它的小学校。

examples.en: A hamlet of forty homes lost its bus.
examples.zh: 这个只有四十户的小村庄失去了公交。

examples.en: The port became an enclave of studios.
examples.zh: 港区成了艺术家聚居的飞地。

examples.en: Votes from the last precinct arrived at midnight.
examples.zh: 最后一个选区的选票午夜才送达。

examples.en: The borough plants trees along every bus route.
examples.zh: 该区沿每条公交线种树。

examples.en: The old grid struggles with rooftop solar.
examples.zh: 老电网难以消纳屋顶光伏。

examples.en: The waterfront reopened as a food market.
examples.zh: 滨水区重新开放为美食市场。
